# Confirmation Engine — 2026-11-25 Setup Replay

**Generated by:** `tools/confirmation_replay.py` from `tools/confirmation_native.py` and `tools/qats_sim/qsmc_ce_replay.inc`.<br>
**Engine:** `MQL5/Experts/QSMC_ConfirmationEngine.mq5`<br>
**Verdict:** **PASS** — 9 deterministic evaluations, 5 parser cases, 9 UTC/DST checks, 7 optional-AI cases, 2 zones kept in the registry, 0 orders sent.<br>
**CSV:** [`docs/confirmation_replay_2026-11-25.csv`](confirmation_replay_2026-11-25.csv), 42 columns, 9 rows, SHA-256 `7cd7cc0d050885d9943257d31266a022d7ac71287a34d25fc9f36a7d2fbcf5b7`.

> This report is an offline replay of the compiled engine. It is **not** MetaEditor F7, **not** Strategy Tester, **not** broker tick data, **not** broker-latency evidence and **not** a live or demo MT5 trading result. The executor is explicitly disarmed: `InpDryRun=true`, `InpAllowLiveOrders=false`, `InpAllowRealTrading=false`; REAL and CONTEST accounts are refused at init.

## 1. Setups and assumptions

| Setup | User-described geometry | Birth (broker chart) | Converted UTC birth | Source-derived facts |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S1 | Bearish OB+FVG `3547.06–3568.91`, MITIGATED, aligned with H4 BOS down | 2026-11-25 01:15:00 broker-server | 2026-11-24 23:15:00Z | `CE_MODE_REVERSAL_AFTER_MITIGATION`; H1/H4 `-1`; second reaction and confirmed close supplied by the replay facts |
| S2 | Bullish OB `3447.85–3464.37`, VALIDATED, counter to H4 BOS down, no retest | 2026-11-25 18:30:00 broker-server | 2026-11-25 16:30:00Z | `CE_MODE_RETEST` for no-retest rows; H4 `-1`, H1 `+1`; HTF is a score/size modifier, not a direction veto |

Assumptions carried from `AUDIT.md`: chart time is broker-server time; winter broker offset is ambiguous between configured UTC+2 (`nadir2.mq5`) and owner-observed UTC+1 (`docs/AUDIT_v6.6.24.md`), so both remain configurable and the replay uses the shipped UTC+2 / EU-DST UTC+3 default. No Experts runtime log, `.set`, account type, broker symbol suffix, tick data, AI endpoint or schema sample was supplied. Current chart objects are `QSVP_ZN_B*/S*` with `Z|...` in tooltips, while the user-described contract also uses `Z|BUY|<epoch>` / `Z|SELL|<epoch>` as object names; both are parsed.

## 2. What the replay proves

- **Parser:** five fixtures cover both `Z|...` object names and current `QSVP_ZN_*` objects/tooltips, including a current object with no tooltip that gets a stable generated ID.
- **State:** MITIGATED is `CE_STATE_TESTED_MITIGATED`, a second-reaction state. S1 reaches `ENTER_DRY_RUN` at London and New York with that state; it is never rejected merely for being MITIGATED.
- **Sessions:** Asia and off-peak rows are refused with `SESSION_PERMISSION`, but the zone registry still contains both zones. Sessions affect scoring and entry permission, never zone existence.
- **UTC/DST:** EU and US spring/fall edges are checked around 01:00Z and 07:00Z/06:00Z boundaries. The EU fall-back ambiguity deterministically maps to the winter offset, so one server-to-UTC round-trip is intentionally non-exact.
- **HTF:** S2 counter-H4 rows still score tier B and receive a reduced `risk_scale=0.30`; the rejection is `ENTRY_MODE_NOT_READY` (no retest) or `SESSION_PERMISSION`, not a rigid HTF veto.
- **AI:** disabled, missing, timeout, malformed, stale and direction-mismatch cases fall back without the opinion dominating. A valid opinion contributes 3.6 of at most 5 points; the denominator becomes 100 only when AI is used. A `KILL_SWITCH` still blocks even with a valid AI opinion.
- **Risk/observability:** every evaluation calls the real score, decision, plan, structured `CE|key=value` log, 42-column CSV row and top-three panel update. No `CE_PlaceOrder` call is made; `orders_sent=0`.

| Case | AI used | Load reason | Score reason | AI points | Available max |

| disabled | false | AI_DISABLED | AI_DISABLED | 0 | 95 |
| valid | true | AI_OK | AI_OK | 3.6 | 100 |
| missing | false | AI_FILE_MISSING | AI_FILE_MISSING | 0 | 95 |
| timeout | false | AI_TIMEOUT | AI_TIMEOUT | 0 | 95 |
| malformed | false | AI_DIRECTION_MISSING | AI_DIRECTION_MISSING | 0 | 95 |
| stale | false | AI_STALE_OR_FUTURE | AI_STALE_OR_FUTURE | 0 | 95 |
| direction_mismatch | true | AI_OK | AI_DIRECTION_MISMATCH | 0 | 100 |

The kill-switch invariant is `PASS`: a fully confident valid opinion cannot loosen the account gate.

## 11. Operator-only steps still required

1. Compile `MQL5/Experts/QSMC_ConfirmationEngine.mq5` with MetaEditor F7.
2. Run an XAUUSD M1 every-tick variable-spread Strategy Tester study with real broker ticks for at least three months.
3. Run a 24-hour MT5 DEMO paper observation with the executor disarmed and compare terminal Experts/CSV logs to these rows.
4. Only after those steps and an explicit, separate authorisation decision may an operator consider arming live orders. This repository does not ship that authorisation.

**No live trading is enabled by this replay or by the default inputs.**
